[[File:Radar_turret_SWNES.jpg|thumb|219px|A radar turret on Tatooine]]
'''Radar turrets''' were immobile [[Radar/Legends|radar]] posts that were utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the Empire installed various radar turrets throughout [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] desert landscape.<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], while driving [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|his landspeeder]] through the desert, had to avoid the radar posts.<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref>
